Gramlot 0.2.2 ships the theme and the logo files in the npm, PyPI and JSR packages. The runtime behaviour is that of 0.2.1.

## What changes

- Theme and logo: `themes/gramlot-base/theme.css` and, of `assets/branding/`, the four stable logo entry points and the 24 SVG variants of `svg/` are in all three packages. npm exports `./themes/*` and `./assets/branding/*`; the wheel carries them under `gramlot/resources/`; JSR keeps them at the package root and no longer carries the rest of the identity kit. Paths: [GC-090 §023](https://github.com/gramlot-org/gramlot/blob/main/docs/public/090-classes-and-hosts.md#gc-090-023).
- Names: "native" no longer names a release, profile, module or API (gramlot-org/gramlot#5). The standalone exporter is `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless` (gramlot-js-server 0.2.2), formerly `@gramlot/gramlot-browser`.
- Releases: the npm job publishes the tarball by relative path, as npm 12 requires.

## Upgrading from 0.2.1

- JavaScript: core imports are unchanged. For standalone exports, replace `@gramlot/gramlot-browser` with `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless`; the subpaths `/directory`, `/standalone` and `/worker-host` are unchanged.
- Python: no change.
